builder.name: Teamzo - Sales, How it works & Support
builder.description: Teamzo's own WhatsApp assistant: explains how the product works, guides buying (by need or self-serve), books demos and handles support / help-center questions. Leads are tagged hot, interested, support or general.

2. Connect your WhatsApp number (scan the QR)
3. Import contacts or build your first chatbot flow
4. Send your first campaign

The in-app *Setup Guide* walks you through each step.

nodes.title: Can't log in
nodes.message:
🔐 *Login problems*
• Check email and password (use *Forgot password* on the login page)
• Make sure your plan/trial is still active
• Staff: ask your account owner to confirm your portal access is enabled
• Try another browser or clear cache

nodes.title: Connect WhatsApp
nodes.message:
📱 *Connecting WhatsApp*
• Open WhatsApp Sessions and tap connect to show the QR
• On your phone: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device → scan
• Keep the phone online while linking
• If it disconnects, reconnect and rescan the QR

nodes.title: Campaign not sending
nodes.message:
📢 *Campaign not sending*
• Is your WhatsApp session connected?
• Check your daily/sender limit hasn't been reached
• For WhatsApp Cloud, the template must be approved
• Make sure contacts have valid numbers and consent

nodes.title: Chatbot not replying
nodes.message:
🤖 *Chatbot not replying*
• Is the flow switched on (active)?
• Does the customer's message match the trigger keyword?
• Is the connected WhatsApp session online?
• Check the flow's active dates, if you set any

nodes.title: Leads not assigned
nodes.message:
🎯 *Leads not being assigned*
• Assignment Rules → is *Auto-assign new leads* on?
• Are staff marked available (not busy/offline)?
• Check any Category & campaign routing rule's staff and dates
• Your plan must include the chosen assignment method
